related.title: OpenFGA：父子繼承、交集與封鎖集合
related.titleEn: OpenFGA: parent inheritance, intersections and blocked users
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：4與1個修訂可重算，版本等於105才滿足新鮮度門檻；未把修訂差轉成不存在的毫秒保證。 交付causal-auth.csv、事件偏序圖與舊快照反例；明確註記整數修訂只為教學抽象。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce gaps of four and one, satisfy the freshness boundary at revision 105, and make no unsupported conversion from revision distance to milliseconds. Deliver causal-auth.csv, the partial-order event diagram and stale-snapshot counterexample, explicitly labeling integer revisions as an educational abstraction.
related.difference: 建立10名合成使用者、兩個資料夾與文件的tuple清單；標記直接讀者、父層讀者及封鎖者，對每個判定保存最短證明路徑。
related.differenceEn: Build tuples for ten synthetic users, two folders and a document. Mark direct readers, parent readers and blocked users, retaining a minimal proof path for each decision rather than reporting only aggregate counts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地模型要求檢查快照不舊於指定修訂；不足者等待或回報不可判定。等待缺口為max(0,要求版本−已見版本)，它不是時間延遲測量。 內容讀取要求至少修訂105，快取只見101；另保留修訂100的舊允許與105的撤權結果，清楚標示不能混用。 落後max(0,105−101)=4個修訂；快取推進至104後仍落後1，不能因接近而當成已符合。
本地模型將直接與繼承讀者取聯集，再扣除封鎖集合；同一使用者有兩條路徑仍只計一次。規則必須以選定模型ID固定，避免測試途中換模型。 讀者聯集共8人，其中2人被封鎖；總使用者10人，另2人沒有任何讀取路徑。 有效讀者(8−2)/10×100=60%；另封鎖一名原本有效讀者後為(8−3)/10×100=50%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local model requires an authorization snapshot at least as new as a specified revision. An older snapshot waits or yields unavailable. Its gap is max(0,required−observed), a revision count rather than a measured time delay. A content read requires revision 105 while the cache has observed 101. Retain an old allow at revision 100 and a revocation at 105, explicitly showing that a valid old decision cannot satisfy the newer consistency requirement. The gap is max(0, 105−101)=4 revisions. Advancing the cache to 104 leaves one revision outstanding; being close does not satisfy the requested consistency boundary.

The local model unions direct and inherited readers, then subtracts blocked users. Count a user once even when two paths grant access. Pin the authorization model ID so a changed model cannot silently alter the interpretation during evaluation. The reader union contains eight users, two of whom are blocked. Ten users form the fixed population; the other two have no read path. Explicitly list overlaps between direct and inherited grants to avoid double counting. Effective readership is (8−2)/10×100=60 percent. Blocking one additional previously eligible reader gives (8−3)/10×100=50 percent, while the inherited and direct grant sets remain unchanged.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Sigstore Bundle：離線證據與簽署時間有效期
related.titleEn: Sigstore bundles: offline evidence and signing-time validity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：4與1個修訂可重算，版本等於105才滿足新鮮度門檻；未把修訂差轉成不存在的毫秒保證。 交付causal-auth.csv、事件偏序圖與舊快照反例；明確註記整數修訂只為教學抽象。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce gaps of four and one, satisfy the freshness boundary at revision 105, and make no unsupported conversion from revision distance to milliseconds. Deliver causal-auth.csv, the partial-order event diagram and stale-snapshot counterexample, explicitly labeling integer revisions as an educational abstraction.
related.difference: 建立產物摘要、憑證鏈、簽章、可信時間證據及信任根版本表；區分Rekor v1時間證據與v2的獨立TSA路徑，依選定驗證器版本固定格式。
related.differenceEn: Record artifact digest, certificate chain, signature, trusted time evidence and trust-root revision. Distinguish the Rekor v1 timestamp path from v2 use of an independent TSA, pinning the chosen verifier and bundle format rather than mixing incompatible assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地模型要求檢查快照不舊於指定修訂；不足者等待或回報不可判定。等待缺口為max(0,要求版本−已見版本)，它不是時間延遲測量。 內容讀取要求至少修訂105，快取只見101；另保留修訂100的舊允許與105的撤權結果，清楚標示不能混用。 落後max(0,105−101)=4個修訂；快取推進至104後仍落後1，不能因接近而當成已符合。
本課先假設鏈、時間簽章與身分政策通過，再計算簽署時間距有效期兩端的較小餘裕；此數值不是撤銷或來源政策的替代。 憑證有效區間1000至1600秒，可信簽署時間1300秒；觀測時刻可以晚於憑證到期，但必須保有符合選定驗證流程的歷史時間證據。 兩端餘裕min(1300−1000,1600−1300)=300秒；可信時間改1550後較小餘裕50秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local model requires an authorization snapshot at least as new as a specified revision. An older snapshot waits or yields unavailable. Its gap is max(0,required−observed), a revision count rather than a measured time delay. A content read requires revision 105 while the cache has observed 101. Retain an old allow at revision 100 and a revocation at 105, explicitly showing that a valid old decision cannot satisfy the newer consistency requirement. The gap is max(0, 105−101)=4 revisions. Advancing the cache to 104 leaves one revision outstanding; being close does not satisfy the requested consistency boundary.

After independent chain, timestamp-signature and identity-policy checks pass, calculate the smaller distance from signing time to the certificate validity endpoints. This number does not replace revocation considerations, provenance policy or verification of the timestamp authority. The certificate interval is 1000 through 1600 seconds and trusted signing time is 1300. Observation may occur later, but acceptance requires historical time evidence appropriate to the selected verification workflow, not merely a certificate that once existed. Endpoint margin is min(1300−1000, 1600−1300)=300 seconds. Moving trusted signing time to 1550 reduces it to 50 seconds, while leaving artifact and identity checks independently necessary.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
